entities.name: Hryhorii Kvitka-Osnovianenko

entities.summary: Hryhorii Fedorovych Kvitka-Osnovianenko was a Ukrainian writer, journalist, and playwright. Founder of Ukrainian classicist prose. He was born in the vicinity of Kharkiv.
